title: Robust Multi-step Model Predictive Control with Guaranteed Stability
summary: We present a method of ensuring recursive feasibility and input-to-state stability of robust nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC) with multi-step predictors. Although feasibility guarantees are well-established for the case of single-step models applied recursively over a finite horizon, such guarantees are missing in naive MPC formulations that use distinct multi-step models to predict the system state at different future points in time.
